notes: Partition verified: 24 source and 30 target ids each used exactly once across 24 units.
The princes of Moab clause is verbless with a prepositional predicate, but the ASV supplies no copula, so אִתּוֹ takes only with him and rule 49 has nothing further to place.
The suffix on הִנֵּה takes the English subject pronoun under rule 18, so the participle keeps only was standing; this is why the division differs from NUM.23.6.
